batting.dismissal: c Dhruv Jurel b N Burger

batting.name: MW Short
batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: S Dube
batting.dismissal: c Ravi Bishnoi b RA Jadeja

batting.name: Noor Ahmad
batting.dismissal: c Dhruv Jurel b JC Archer

batting.name: V Suryavanshi
batting.dismissal: c SN Khan b A Kamboj

balls.text: Has a hoick, doesn't time it. Rolls to deep midwicket, Hetmyer throws it casually to the keeper. Overton ambled the first, as he finished the run he realised he can nick a second. But the throw, on the bounce, came to the keeper at a good height. Off went the bails and he ran through towards the pavillion
Kamboj manages to turn strike. Length ball on leg, flicked to midwicket and the 'CSK' chants return
Shows the stumps, drives the yorker on leg to long-off. Can't nick a two
Met with! No venom on the bouncer, landed very short but didn't rise much. Overton made room and pulled it, almost got a whiplash as the ball sailed over wide long-on
Bouncer seems to have hit him on the grille as Overton swivelled for the pull. It was on the peak of the helmet replay shows. Goes to short fine leg. Concussion test will take place
Edge goes through first slip but there's essentially a deep first slip too. Stopped there. Length ball just outside off, Kamboj tried to punch it through cover
Wide on a length, caressed with a flat-bat to long-off
Looks to slice it across the line, the length ball beats him and hits the thigh. Deflects to the off side
Free hit is a slower one that's helped away with one hand. Bottom hand comes off as Kamboj went for the pull, was too early into the shot but got enough for it to go over backward square leg
Pacy and at the stumps from around the wicket, defended to the bowler. 141ks. Uh-oh, Burger has overstepped
Length over off, clears the front leg and slaps it to cover
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg
Length on off, flicked to deep midwicket
Chipped... just past the bowler. Sandeep jumped to the right in follow-through as the ball floated but it was too far. Pitched-up legcutter foxed Overton, too early into the straight drive
Too straight, Kamboj goes to off stump and inside the line of the length ball. Looks to flick fine, misses, ball goes fine off the pad anyway
Full and slow outside off, whipped into the outfield. Rolls to long-on
Slower bouncer has been swat-pulled from head-high. Top edge flies over short fine leg and rolls into the cushion
Yorker nailed on off, jammed to long-off
Thick edge flies and rolls to the deep-third fence, Archer smiles. Cleared the front leg and tried to drive the full ball over cover.
Beaten again, two more balls left Jofra says to Overton as he grunts. He checks with the square-leg ump for height. Not given. Was a short ball on leg, he tried to pull it
Full toss goes over the stumps, surprising how it didn't hit. Overton went across early for the lap, tried to scoop it and missed. Ball went over middle
Beaten again. This was rapid. Back of length, trying to follow the batter as he made room. Beaten on the pull
Into the pitch just outside off, looks to pull it across and misses. Ball goes over bat
Full and a touch slow again, looks to flick to midwicket. Hits pad and goes into the ground
Length down leg, goes past the leg glance. Keeper half-stops it
Length outside off, punched to cover

Lobbed back to the bowler. Bishnoi takes a low catch, falls back, gets up and raises his arms. Slowed down again, it's full and on off. Henry lunged forward and was too early into the drive. Didn't check his shot and has to walk back
Back of length on leg, 94ks which is a touch slower for him, beats the flick and hits pad
Flat and fast on middle, looks to defend straight. Inside edge goes to square leg
Slower bouncer has been picked up... Jaiswal does nicely at deep midwicket. Dives left and saves three. Overton hit that into the ground from around head-height. Timeout
Slower one outside off, length ball is dragged to long-on
Edge goes through first slip. Touch too high and wide for the keeper. Henry backing away as he pulls this back of length ball around hip-height
Yorker attempted, full toss delivered. Henry may have though that was higher than it was, takes an extra second and flicks it to midwicket
Too wide for the pull. Pre-meditated shot, Henry hopped and tried to drag it leg side from around head-height. Misses. Good bounce on that
Touch fuller than length just outside off, square driven to deep point
Short just outside off, tennis-style swat-pull goes to long-on
Length on leg, defended to cover
Gets inside the line of the shortish ball that seemed slow, goes for the pull and misses. Tight call goes in the bowler's favour
Hits the back bicep, on the fleshy part close to the elbow. Back of length ball on off rushes him as he tries to flick it square. Ball goes to the off side. Physio comes to check in
Swipes and misses. Back of length just outside off, goes with a flat-bat, bottom hand almost comes off and clanks inward
Backs away and the length ball from around the wicket arrows into him. Punches it back to the bowler
Overton wants the strike, it'll be a tight second... He makes it. Length on leg, flicked to midwicket
No, but Henry has a go. Misses. Full ball outside off, not dissimilar from the last one. Henry stands still and looks to slap it over cover

Thick edge, keeper takes it. Noor shows all his stumps, hoping to get one maybe around middle or off. It goes just outside off and he looks to slash it through cover. He's a bit too far away again and hands a regulation catch
Another pull beaten, sharper bouncer this time. Over the stumps, Noor was beside the line of the ball and swung well under it
Pacy ball halfway down. Lands around off and goes away outside off, Noor looks to pull but it's too far away
Pitched up on off, driven to mid-off
Driven through extra with bottom hand gently sliding off the bat. Mid-off has to chase, does well Parag, slides and palms the ball in close to the boundary. Archer just a touch too full
Slowed down and that buys turn. Lands on a length just outside off and turns away sharply. Noor looks to punch through cover, gets a thick edge to short third
Touch short, too straight. Overton looks to pul it fine, misses and gets pad on it. Goes to short fine leg

They steal two again, inside edge works in Overton's favour as the ball goes in the vacant midwicket region. Fullish ball down leg, Overton was sliding down leg too, looked to defend straight with bat a bit away from the body
Length just down leg, Overton slides leg side and looks to flick. Misses and gets hit on the pad
Lunges forward and knocks the length ball on off to long-off
Full outside off, driven to long-off
Slower shortish ball just outside off, defended to cover point. 105ks
Edge? No. Noor goes for the pull, the bouncer is around middle stump and just over the shoulder. Goes above the top edge
Shortish ball rises around the ribs, 132ks, worked back to the bowler

That should be out, finger goes up. Kartik chats... and takes the review. 134ks full ball on middle and leg. Kartik's forward stride was small and he tried to drive it through mid-on. Bat well in front of body, beat the inside-edge and hit the outer-half of the front pad. On the shin. Ball-tracking shows it's hitting leg stump and Brijesh has his first IPL wicket.
Nudged smartly to the edge of the ring at midwicket and they steal two. Length ball on middle and leg
Down leg. Fullish length ball goes past the attempted stand-up sweep
Action seems similar to Sreesanth's. Shortish ball on leg stump, not much bounce, inside edge off the flick goes off the body to the off side
fullish ball on middle, and nudged to midwicket as Jadeja himself gives the chase
pinged down the ground!! He simply leans into the loft off this fullish ball on off, as he skips down the ground to attack. A rare positive for CSK
full and quick, and darted into off. Overton pushes it back

this could have been tight, but the throw was too high for Jurel to collect. Jaiswal at point rushed forward and threw, but too high. Kartik defended this full ball outside off towards point, and took off
fuller ball, and straighter. Driven back to Jadeja
On a length on off, and slightly turning away to beat Kartik, who looked to defend
short in length, and again at 103kph. This arrives around sixth stump, and is slapped to deep-backward point
very full, and outside off again. Dragged to midwicket
good bounce off a length around sixth stump. He goes back to block to Bishnoi
fuller and flatter, and fired at 103kph. Driven from outside off to cover point
short in length, and turning in to finish close to off. Cut away to point
very full, and outside off. Kartik leans into the drive wide of long-off

number six!! Jadeja's experience trumps Dube's aggression. The RR spinner goes full and wider of off, tempting Dube to launch him down the ground again. Dube takes the bait, but ends up finding long-off. It was a bit of a cat and mouse between the two right from the first ball, and Jadeja won't mind taking the wicket after being hit for six first ball
outside edge, but dribbling to short third. This ball is quicker and shorter, and outside off
looks to jab off this length ball outside off, but is beaten
six first ball!! CSK's designated spin hitter says I'll do it right away. A free swing of the arms off this full ball around off, and the ball disappears over long-on

Jurel and Jadeja are delighted while appealing, and Sarfaraz is given lbw. But he reviews. Sarfaraz went sweeping, but missed, as the ball went beneath his bat. The first replay hints that it could be too high as he's hit on his back, but we'll see. No bat involved is the confirmation from the third umpire. Ohh, in fact, the ball pitches on middle, and straightens enough for Ball Tracking to project it to hit the top of middle. Jadeja strikes in his first over
on a length, and a little wide of off. Slashed to point while playing away from his body

over deep-backward square leg!! Yet another short delivery from Bishnoi, who pitched it on middle. There was hardly any turn either way, and Kartik went back in the crease to dispatch that for his first six
short of a length, and slightly wide of off. A late cut to deep point to keep ticking
another short delivery. This turns in from middle, and finishes on leg. Punched to deep midwicket again
short ball at Sarfaraz on off. The latter goes down on his back leg, and pulls to deep midwicket
short of a length on off, and it straightens after pitching. Punched to cover for a hurried run
starts with a quickish ball, which is full and outside off. Driven back by Kartik
another one at a lack of pace. Sandeep floats this on a fullish length on the stumps, and Sarfaraz blocks it back
much fuller ball, and just outside off. This time Kartik leans into a drive to long-on
Short delivery to the new batter. The ball rises close to middle and off, and Kartik swat-pulls to deep square leg for two quick runs

chipped to midwicket!! Jaiswal, who took the catch, almost gestures that he couldn't spot the ball. The ball stopped on the pitch before coming on to Short, who ended up pushing at it aerially off a fullish length on the stumps. Or maybe Sandeep with a lack of pace. Either way, Short falls as CSK lose their fourth within the powerplay
fullish ball on middle, and flicked to square leg
slower ball first up. Short of a length, and shaping into middle. Clipped to fine leg

another four for Sarfaraz!! He wasn't entirely in control there, but he'll take it. His top hand came off the bat as he went pulling off this short ball shaping in to finish on leg. The man at short fine leg was beaten comfortably in the end
short in length on middle, and Short pulls it to fine leg. The ball didn't get up as much as the length threatened, though
another dot ball. Brijesh bowls on a short of a length on off, and Short dabs it to cover point
slapped on the bounce to the man at cover point. Short of a length from Brijesh just outside off, and Short hacks hard at it
fullish length around off, and driven to extra cover
another wide from RR. This ball swings in and lands full and outside leg. Short looked to flick, but the ball was too wide
Fuller side of a length around sixth stump, and driven back to Brijesh

RR go up for a caught-behind chance again... and again the umpire is firm. RR don't review this time. Burger bowls on the fuller side, and gets the ball to finish outside off. Sarfaraz went for the drive but was beaten. My first impression was that his bat hit his pad. Nope, the bat hit his pad rather. Replays show the ball would have gone over the stumps
wide outside leg. Burger bowls on the fuller side of a length, and Sarfaraz looks to clip from off, but misses
bang!! Sarfaraz countering for CSK. He decides to skip down the pitch, and converts this into a length ball outside leg. He whips it hard over fine leg for the first six of the day

pulled to deep square leg, but not very confidently. Short ball on middle, and seaming away to finish close to off. Sarfaraz doesn't entirely convincingly go behind, but still pulls well enough for four
ohh, good pace, and a tight line. Short of a length on middle, and Sarfaraz has to push himself back to dab it down off a short of a length
hat-trick is avoided. Burger bowls on the fuller side of a length on off, and Sarfaraz pushes it from deep in the crease to cover

loud appeal for caught behind - and with extreme confidence from Burger and Jurel - but it's turned down. RR review, though. It was a bouncer from Burger that left Mhatre nearly cramped. The ball landed on leg, and took off to pass close to Mhatre's head. He looked to pull that late, but was beaten by the pace and the bounce. Ohh, there's a spike on UltraEdge as the ball zips past the glove. It brushes his bottom thumb, and Mhatre has to go. A first-ball duck for Mhatre, and CSK have lost three wickets already. In fact, Burger is on a hat-trick

gone!! Archer wins the battle against an off-colour Gaikwad. Again the CSK captain looked to make room and attack, but this time failed to get bat on ball. Archer kept the ball fullish and straight, and Gaikwad, looking to open the face of the bat and perhaps slice it, missed. The stumps lit up. There was the swag on Archer's face after launching that ball at 143kph
good take by Jurel; he has saved potentially four runs. Shortish in length on leg, and Gaikwad missed as he looked to swipe. Jurel dived full length to his left to take that

finally he gets one away. The crowd, with plenty of away supporters, is up with that. Another full ball from Archer in that sixth- or seventh-stump channel, and this time Gaikwad drills the ball through cover

A frustrated Gaikwad tries something different, but the result remains the same. Short of a length from Archer around off, and Gaikwad slashes by backing away. But the ball goes on the bounce to point
Another dot. Gaikwad has now faced eight balls for just two runs. Full again, and on off. Pushed to mid-on
drives it well, but straight to the man at short cover. Fuller delivery from Archer, and again in the channel outside off, but Gaikwad can't find the gap
Archer bowls on a length, and in the corridor just outside off. Gaikwad drives forward, but gets it off the inside half of the to mid-on

bowled him!! The off stump is flattened. Burger fires one at 140kph, and Samson is beaten after looking to heave across the line. On a length on middle, and the ball seams away after pitching. Samson went swinging without any foot movement, and missed. His first innings in yellow, against the side he made a name with, is cut short early
good running. Gaikwad taps this length delivery on middle, and the ball trickles behind the wicket. Gaikwad calls, and Samson responds
too wide outside leg. Burger goes fullish and wide of leg. Gaikwad, deep in the crease, looks to swipe but is beaten
extra bounce for Burger. He bowls this on a short of a length leg. Gaikwad looks to nudge, but is hit high on his body
nudged late, and he gets four. In fact, it's given leg byes. Shortish in length, and swinging in to pitch just outside leg. Gaikwad looked to clip, but the ball hit his thigh and beat the keeper
fuller side of a length at 140kph. This is floated on leg, and is tapped to cover point
shorter side of a length on middle, and angling across from over the wicket. Samson dabs it gently to point for a single
a length delivery swinging into middle and off. Clipped to fine leg

edged between short third and the keeper!! The former fielder was brought in just before this ball. Archer goes fullish and just outside off, and Samson drives again. But this time he gets an outside edge right in the gap
nicely bowled!! Samson is beaten outside off. Archer bowls full, and around fifth stump. Samson goes driving off the front foot but misses, as the ball zips past the outside edge
short of a length around middle and off, and nudged to square leg to get off the mark immediately
on a length, and swinging in to pitch on middle. Samson looks to clip, but it hits his pad to dribble to square leg
fullish delivery pitching around sixth stump, and pushed to short mid-on off the inside half of the bat
Royals win with nearly eight overs to spare. They get there with a gentle tuck off the pads to midwicket. Sedate celebrations
Nails the middle-stump yorker. Parag was on middle and off, didn't pre-meditate and was able to jam it right in front

That looked wide on first view. Not given, RR review. 133ks bouncer on fifth stump. Parag was on the hop as he tried to upper-cut it fine. Ball went over the bat but that was after it passed him. Head height is 1.83 metres and the ball is 1.89 metres. Decision reversed
Short ball just outside off is pulled into the ground. Goes to deep midwicket
Looks like Steve Smith as he slants himself, closes his stance and punches the full ball to long-on
Pulls the short ball to deep midwicket's right. Stopped with a tumble
Looks to drive it straight off the front foot, gets an inside edge to wide long-on
Shot of the day! Utter disrespect charging at a pacer, smashing the scramble-seam ball from middle from well down leg. Sails over long-off
Gets the reverse this time! Flat over deep point it sails. Shifted the stance but not the grip, Parag's hands were swift as he swiped low at the fullish ball at the stumps
Goes for the reverse, the shortish ball goes off the glove to the keeper's right
Dropped by Henry at deep-backward square. Ran in, slid with the knee going in front. Jaiswal looking to sweep it off a length, got a top edge
Not sure how that missed. Stock ball ripping into a length and then going away to beat Jaiswal's straight swing
A bit outside off and Parag very wristy again. This time with a cut to long-off
Looks to slug it from outside off over cow corner. Gets it off the bottom-half. Along the ground to wide long-on
Catch check. Low one to Kartik at backward point, replay shows he took it on the bounce. Was a fullish ball outside off that Parag tried to punch to cover

Waits for the short one and slaps it over extra cover. It's very short, wide too. May have turned away, Parag went tennis-style, very wristily flat-batted it. Didn't go through with the follow-through fully but timed it perfectly
Pitched up around off, punched to mid-off
Short ball is high, called one for the over. Was dug in at 132ks, went around head-height just outside off. Parag shaped to upper-cut before leaving
Quick single to midwicket. Length ball on middle and leg, Jaiswal walks down and flicks
Back of length on off, run down to deep third
another full ball, but this is around middle. Tapped to point, and Jaiswal is sent back by Parag
full delivery angling across to come on off. Driven to mid-off
looks to defend this full delivery in and around off, and gets an outside edge to deep third
Jurel's outsmarted. He shuffles across and is crawling around the crease trying to paddle the fullish ball. It hits pad and deflects onto the stumps
Looks to punch through cover, french cut goes wide of leg stump... and a misfield in the deep. Khaleel chased to the deep and tried to parry it in while sliding, slid it across to the left instead
Overrpitched and that's clubbed. Jurel walks across and is right behind it, closes the bat-face a touch and gets his bottom hand through the ball. One bounce over long-on
Ramped wide of the keeper. Off the outer-half as Jaiswal limbo-ed leg side. Didn't have much room to work with as the shortish ball went over middle and off, got the bat up and angled it in time
Length in the channel, 138ks, guided to deep third
Change of length but it's too straight. Jurel pounces by pulling the cross-seam ball from around hip-height through backward square leg. Nice swivel too
Full on leg, flicked through midwicket. Mostly along the ground. Wristy shot with both feet inside the crease
Back of length just outside off, goes for the pull. Chunks it into the pitch, to the bowler
Starts with a yorker on off, squeezed out towards backward point
on a length just outside off, and dabbed off the bottom of the bat to the keeper
short in length on middle, and clipped to deep-backward square leg
Jaiswal looks to guide this length ball finishing outside off, but is beaten. A rare dot ball, you'd think
shorter side of a length on middle and off. Nudged to square leg for a quick single

taken at deep extra cover!! Sarfaraz takes a catch while running in and diving forward. Sooryavanshi nearly refuses to leave the field. He eventually goes back disappointed. Kamboj angled this ball across at the left-hander, and bowled at a length. The ball came to Sooryavanshi outside off, and he went lofting through the line. That was hit hard and flat, but went right into Sarfaraz's hands
shorter side of a length on off, and he goes back to dab to point
shortish length outside off, and pulled to deep-backward square leg
a 15-ball fifty!! Sooryavanshi sends the ball close to the RR dugout this time. Another hittable length as Sooryavanshi liberally heaves at it to go towards long-on
cruising into the stands!! Six down the ground. On the slightly shorter side of a length around off, and Sooryavanshi thumps it back over the bowler's head
short of a length outside off, and turning in. Punched to long-on
short in length again, but this is on off. Punched to wide mid-off
Jaiswal goes reverse sweeping, but is beaten. Samson misses as well. Four byes for RR. Noor bowled it short on middle, and the ball went on with the angle to arrive just outside leg for Jaiswal
bang!! The ball flies over the long-on boundary. Fuller side of a length from Kamboj, and just outside off. Sooryavanshi gets his front leg out of the way, and crashes the ball for six more
fuller side of a length, and just outside off. Pushed to mid-on
inside edge, but four still. That's how he bats; he'll go after the bowling no matter where the ball arrives. No foot movement off this full ball arriving around sixth stump, as he looks to drive
upper cut for four to deep third. Sooryavanshi uses his bottom hand to slash it late off a short of a length, as the ball rises on off
Kamboj sees Jaiswal take a step down, and bowls short around off. Jaiswal ends up dabbing it towards square leg
angles it across, and goes on a full length just outside off. Jaiswal looks to drive, but is beaten on the outside edge
full and fast, and swinging into middle and off. Jaiswal flicks it late to deep square leg, almost with bat behind his pad
short in length, and around off. He pulls, and spots the ball going straight to the midwicket fielder. Hence comes the shouts of "nahi, nahi, nahi" for Sooryavanshi
ohh, a late dab, but to the man at short third. Jaiswal waited for this shortish ball to arrive just outside off, and played it down
fuller side of a length, and wide of off. He goes driving but gets an inside edge on to his front leg
launched over mid-off. Jaiswal lofts this length ball just outside off by opening the face of the bat, but the ball comes off the higher side of the bat to dribble into the boundary
nearly a yorker in and around off. He goes heaving across the line, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep square leg
short of a length on off, and he leaps in the crease to slash to deep third

beats deep third moving to his left!! Sooryavanshi plays a combination of a slice and a swat off this length ball which is actually a slower one around sixth stump. But he reads the lack of pace, and rams that away for six
Henry keeps going on the shorter side just outside off, and Jaiswal again cuts it away. Although this one goes to deep third
on the bounce to the deep-third fielder coming forward. Sooryavanshi went hacking at this short-of-a-length ball just outside off, but mistimed it again
short in length, and angling across to end wide of off. Cut away to deep point
short of a length, and seaming away to finish on off. Punched to cover

over point, and a one-bounce four. Sooryavanshi went slicing at it initially, and got it off the top edge, as the ball was on the shorter side of a length around off. More luck goes Sooryavanshi's way
a length delivery this time, but the line is still wider of off. Slapped to deep third as he chases the ball this time
a leave!? Wow. Khaleel goes slightly fuller, but wider of off. Jaiswal doesn't bother throwing his bat at it
beaten!! Tight line from Khaleel. He goes on the fuller side of a length around sixth stump, and Jaiswal goes driving, but sees the ball zip past the inside edge
fuller in length, and arriving just outside off. Jaiswal drives to mid-on

Khaleel nearly begs for this to be given lbw, but the umpire is unmoved. Gaikwad has a word with his bowler... and reviews reluctantly. Sooryavanshi went driving at this short-of-a-length ball seaming into middle, but was beaten on the inside edge. There's no bat involved there, as he's struck on his back pad. Ohh, there's sharp inswing from Khaleel, who bowls short and just outside off, with replays showing the ball would have gone over leg. RR pinched a leg bye, meanwhile

clipped off his pads to beat short fine leg to his right. That is 18 runs off the first over. Jaiswal lets this short-of-a-length ball come on to him on leg, and plays late enough to nudge it past the fielder
looks to pull again, but mistimes it towards point
six over wide long-on!! Sooryavanshi connects well this time. Short of a length, arriving around off, and bashed hard by pulling cleanly for six

dropped by Kartik!! That was a difficult chance, to be fair. And to make it worse, the ball ends up dribbling to the deep-midwicket boundary as Kartik didn't give the chase. Shortish ball outside off, and Sooryavanshi pulled off the higher side of the bat. Kartik turned around at midwicket, and started running forward, with the ball dropping from over his head
short in length this time, and shaping into Jaiswal's hips. He clips it with his bottom hand off the bat to deep-backward square leg
misfield at point by Sarfaraz, and that allows Jaiswal two. Short of a length around fifth stump, and Jaiswal shifted his weight back to slash at it and luckily get two
